about: Round 1558. The two host proof behind every Baseball Connections board the round changed. The record (baseballConnectionsRecord-2026-10.json: the league's data service for each man, and one documented page for each closed list) is one host; each fact here adds a second, independent one (baseball-reference.com player, award and list pages; baseball-almanac.com for no-hitters and the Triple Crown; ESPN for the 2023 World Baseball Classic final; the league's own person record for the schools, whose list host is baseball-reference). Wikis are never a source. A fact is written only where both hosts give the same verdict; the one place they did not is under disputed, with both lines.
rules: A fact names a man, a group label and whether he fits it (holds), and carries two sources on two different hosts, neither a wiki: the record first, the second host after it.
Every member of a group the checker flagged before the round holds his group on two hosts (flaggedGroups lists those groups under their labels after the round).
Every finding the checker made before the round (fixed) has the fact behind it on two hosts: the member who did not fit, or the man from another group who did.
uncheckedCeiling, memberUnknownCeiling and otherUnknownCeiling may only fall: a label, a member or another tile the record cannot judge must not come back.

Round 1567: a pair the record cannot judge is never settled by a new line; it is read on both hosts (grayPairs) and, a coin toss, its man leaves that board in place (rebuilt1567). Every member of a rebuilt group holds it on two hosts (its group is in flaggedGroups).

fix2-1567: a near-line fact (why "near-line") records a man dealt beside a Hall of Fame position group with 8.5 to 9.9 percent of his games at its position, just under the 10 percent line the checker calls out (review-read-1567 minor 3). Each is read on the league record and baseball-reference.com by his share, and on the Hall of Fame's own page by his primary position; none puts him in that group, so the pair stays on its board as decided, not as a coin toss.
